title: berth.toml
description: berth.toml: the committed configuration of a project. Unknown keys are rejected, so a typo cannot silently disable a feature.

name.description: The project's name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

domain.description: Parent domain worktrees are routed under, as <slug>.<domain>, where the slug is derived from the branch name.

label-namespace.description: Docker label namespace, as a reverse domain such as dev.example. Only set this to adopt resources created by a previous tool; new projects should leave it unset.

compose.description: The Compose project each worktree runs.

file.description: Path to the Compose file, relative to this file.

service.description: Services to route and index, one [service.<name>] table each, named by the Compose service. Services not listed here still run; they just are not routed or indexed.

propertyNames.description: The Compose service name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

additionalProperties.description: One routed service. The table's key is its Compose service name.

subdomain.description: Subdomain under the worktree host, so the service is routed at <subdomain>.<slug>.<domain>. Empty (the default) routes at the worktree host root.

path.description: Routes only this URL path prefix, which must start with /, so several services can share one host; also where the printed URL points. Omit to route the whole host.

port.description: Container port to route to. Defaults to the first port the service exposes or publishes.

index.description: Presence on the shared checkout index. Omit to keep the service off the index.

label.description: Name shown for the service on the shared checkout index.

purpose.description: What the service is for, shown beside its label on the checkout index.

shared.description: Services that run once per repository and are shared by all of its worktrees, such as an email catcher.

file.description: Path to the shared services' Compose file, relative to this file. It is its own Compose project, run once per repository, and may not build images or bind-mount paths inside a worktree. Required when any [shared.service.<name>] table is declared.

service.description: Shared services, one [shared.service.<name>] table each, named by the service in the shared Compose file.

propertyNames.description: The shared Compose service name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

additionalProperties.description: One shared service: a service of the shared Compose file that runs once per repository. The table's key is its Compose service name, and the name containers reach it by.

port.description: Container port of the service's web UI, published on a pinned loopback port and routed at <name>.shared.<domain> (BERTH_SHARED_URL_<NAME> is its URL; BERTH_SHARED_ADDR_<NAME>_<PORT> names the pinned address). Omit if the service has no web UI.

ports.description: Container ports published on pinned loopback ports, for processes on the host (an IDE-run app, `berth run`): BERTH_SHARED_ADDR_<NAME>_<PORT> names each address. Containers reach the service at <name>:<port> instead. At most 16 with port.

used-by.description: Services of the worktree's Compose file that use this shared service. A worktree whose Compose file has any of them starts the shared service, and the shared service joins the networks they are on, answering to its name as an alias.

items.description: A service of the worktree's Compose file: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

hooks.description: Commands berth runs at points in a worktree's life. Each is resolved relative to this file when it starts with "." or contains "/", and looked up on PATH otherwise. See docs/hooks.md.

prepare.description: Command run once the services are healthy and before anything is seeded. Migrations belong here.

seed.description: Command that seeds data. Runs only the first time the worktree comes up, and only after prepare exits zero.

verify.description: Command `berth doctor` runs for a registered worktree; exit zero means healthy. Its output goes to stderr.

backup.description: Command a future `berth backup` will run. Accepted and validated now; nothing invokes it yet.

restore.description: Command a future `berth restore` will run. Accepted and validated now; nothing invokes it yet.

commands.description: Named commands for `berth run <name> [-- args...]`: on-demand work that is not part of coming up. Each key is a name of lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

propertyNames.description: The command's name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63 characters.

additionalProperties.description: A command line, or a table with the command line and its options.

anyOf.description: The command line on its own, with the default options.

command.description: The command line, split and resolved exactly as a hook is. See docs/hooks.md.

lock.description: Hold the worktree's operation lock while the command runs, so `up`, `down` and a second `run` wait. false skips only the lock; it is trusted, not enforced.

kill-after.description: How long the command's process group has to exit once asked to stop, before it is killed: a duration such as 30s, 5m or 1m30s, greater than zero and at most 1h.
